description: Make `you submit` success output actionable for humans and scripts by returning workId, name, and workTypeName from POST /work, emitting a structured --json confirmation object (including sessionId and endpointPath), improving failure messages, and documenting the submit-to-verify loop in agent docs.

context.customerAsk: Implement tasks/prd-cli-submit-response-contract.md: actionable success output and --json workId fields for you submit.
context.problem: Successful you submit only prints a trace id (human) or encodes SubmitWorkResponse with traceId alone (--json). Operators and agents cannot verify the created work without immediately running you work list, which led to duplicate submits and missed verification during docs PRD exercises.
context.solution: Extend POST /work SubmitWorkResponse with workId, name, and workTypeName; update you submit human and JSON stdout to include identifiers plus CLI routing metadata and a verify hint; clarify non-201 failures; document the submit, wait, and verify loop in you docs agents and you docs work.

acceptanceCriteria: On HTTP 201, human you submit prints name, workTypeName, traceId, workId when returned, and a one-line you work show or you work list --name hint.
On HTTP 201 with global --json, stdout is one JSON object with workId, name, workTypeName, traceId, sessionId, and endpointPath.
Non-201 submit exits non-zero with bounded API error text and no success confirmation on stdout.
OpenAPI SubmitWorkResponse and generated types include workId, name, and workTypeName; API tests assert the success body.
you docs agents and you docs work document submit success fields and the verify loop using camelCase names aligned with CLI JSON.
Quality gate: backend and CLI typecheck, lint, and relevant tests pass before merge.

userStories.title: API returns work identifiers on submit
userStories.description: As an API client, I want POST /work and session-scoped submit to return workId, name, and workTypeName with traceId so I know which work was accepted without listing.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAPI SubmitWorkResponse includes workId, name, and workTypeName alongside traceId; generated server types are regenerated.
POST /work and POST /factory-sessions/{sessionId}/work success bodies populate workId, name, workTypeName, and traceId for a valid single-work submit.
workId matches normalized submit id (batch-<requestId>-<name> when caller omits explicit workId).
API unit test asserts success response JSON includes all identifier fields.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Human success output and verify hint
userStories.description: As an operator, I want you submit to print what was created and a suggested follow-up command so I can verify without guessing filters.
acceptanceCriteria: On HTTP 201, stdout includes name, workTypeName, traceId, and workId when the API returns it.
Prints one follow-up hint: you work show <work-id> when workId is non-empty, otherwise you work list --name <name>.
Does not print full HTTP body or request payload on stdout; verbose diagnostics stay on stderr.
CLI httptest asserts human stdout contains identifiers and the hint for an enriched 201 response.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: JSON success confirmation object
userStories.description: As a script author, I want you --json submit to emit one parseable object with identifiers and routing metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: On HTTP 201 with global --json, stdout is one JSON object with workId, name, workTypeName, traceId, sessionId, and endpointPath.
sessionId reflects effective --session labeling; endpointPath matches the scoped submit path used for the request.
Exit code is 0 on success.
CLI test unmarshals stdout and asserts all required keys and values against a mocked 201 response.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Clear failure output without false success
userStories.description: As an agent, I want submit failures to be obvious so I do not treat a rejection as success or re-submit blindly.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-201 responses exit non-zero with no success confirmation line on stdout.
Error text includes HTTP status and bounded ErrorResponse.message when parseable.
When error JSON includes a work identifier, error text mentions it.
Transport unreachable errors remain distinct from API rejection messages.
CLI tests cover HTTP 400 with ErrorResponse and unreachable server cases.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Document submit verify loop for agents
userStories.description: As an agent author, I want you docs agents and you docs work to describe how to confirm a submit using the new output fields.
acceptanceCriteria: you docs agents documents submit, wait, and verify using you submit success fields and you work show or you work list --name.
you docs work documents POST /work success fields and CLI --json confirmation fields with camelCase names.
pkg/cli/docs content tests pass after updates.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
